items.title: Laravel 13 queue batching, explained
items.text: Laravel 13 changes how queued job batches retry failed jobs: a batch can now be retried as a whole, and the failure callback runs once per batch.

items.title: Backpressure in Rust job queues: what we learned
items.text: A write-up of how a Rust job queue added backpressure so that stalled workers stop accepting new jobs, with the failure modes that forced the design.
